author: fwyzard
body: #### PR description: The streamer output modules accept `compression_algorithm` "LZ4", with `compression_level` 1 for the fast LZ4 compressor, 2 for the "mid" compressor introduced in LZ4 v1.10.0, and 3-12 for LZ4 HC. ROOT currently does not use levels 2 and 3 (but see root-project/root#23748) and stops at level 9. Compressed events start with the `L4` header, and the input sources and `DiagStreamerFile` detect and decompress them like the other algorithms. The output tests now take a compression level; NewStreamer run the round trip at levels 1 (fast), 2 ("mid") and 4 (HC). LZ4 is faster than zstd level 1, but creates significantly larger files. LZ4HC is as slow as zlib and zstd, so it's only useful when the fastest decompression is needed. #### PR validation: Unit tests pass. Streamer files in LZ4 format were read back and used to measure the Phase 2 HLT performance.
title: Add LZ4 compression to the streamer format
